title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A class is not its own parent
summary: A class with a multi line constructor and no supertype list borrowed one from the first declaration below it, usually a method's return type. A sealed class ended up extending itself and the type hierarchy listed it as its own subtype.

highlights.title: The header stops where the constructor closes
highlights.description: Reading on past the closing parenthesis found a method's return type twelve lines below and made it a supertype of the class.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A supertype list is read only until the constructor closes. On a real Android project 50 supertypes were taken from a declaration further down, every one of them a method return type; the sealed classes among them ended up extending themselves.

The type hierarchy asks the same question as the lens and Go to Implementation. It still used a package heuristic and never excluded the type itself, so 21 types were listed as their own subtype and expanding one looped.
